cases.name: follow-up phrase types into the new note
menu command in Chrome
cases.note: Was a known limit (2026-09-22): Chrome's profile picker window ('Who's using Chrome?') was open and is Chrome's key window, so AXPress on File › New Tab, ⌘T through the HID tap, and the strip's + button all left the tab count at 17. Passed with the picker closed on 2026-09-28 (runs/2026-09-28T12-10-14Z) and untagged. The executor falls back from AXPress to the item's own shortcut and verifies new/closed tabs by the strip's tab count. If it fails again, check for the picker first (`jev-cua ax --tabs`).

cases.name: repeat the last action
cases.note: Notes reuses an empty note, so the repeat verifies through the focused empty body rather than the row count.
